title: Prakrama 2, Sarga 12. The Great Manifestation and the Ablution
html:
The Lord returns from the northern bank of the Ganga; Murari consoles Him; the Lord reveals His great majesty, and the devotees bathe and worship Him

Verse 1

ततो वाट्यां मुरारेस्ते झटित्यागत्य सेश्वराः।
उपविश्य क्षणं स्थित्वा विजयस्याश्रमं ययुः॥१॥

tato vāṭyāṁ murāreste jhaṭityāgatya seśvarāḥ|
upaviśya kṣaṇaṁ sthitvā vijayasyāśramaṁ yayuḥ||1||

tatah — then; vatyam — to the house; murareh — of Murari; te — they; jhatiti — quickly; agatya — having come; sa-ishvarah — together with the Lord; upavishya — sitting down; kshanam — a while; sthitva — having stayed; vijayasya — of Vijaya; ashramam — to the dwelling; yayuh — went.

1Then together with the Lord they hurried to Murari's house; having sat there a little while, they went on to the dwelling of Vijaya1.

Verse 2

उषित्वा रजनीं तत्र प्रभाते भगवान्परः।
जगामोत्तरकं कूलं स जाह्नव्या भ्रमद्द्रुतम्॥२॥

uṣitvā rajanīṁ tatra prabhāte bhagavānparaḥ|
jagāmottarakaṁ kūlaṁ sa jāhnavyā bhramaddrutam||2||

ushitva — having spent; rajanim — the night; tatra — there; prabhate — at dawn; bhagavan — Bhagavan; parah — the Supreme; jagama — went; uttarakam — northern; kulam — to the bank; sah — He; jahnavyah — of the Jahnavi; bhraman — wandering; drutam — swiftly.

2Having spent the night there, at dawn the Supreme Bhagavan went to the northern bank of the Jahnavi and roamed swiftly about.

Verse 3

ब्राह्मणाः साधवः शान्ता विनयेन द्विजोत्तमाः।
ऊचुः प्रसीद भगवन्नागच्छ स्वगृहं पुनः॥३॥

brāhmaṇāḥ sādhavaḥ śāntā vinayena dvijottamāḥ|
ūcuḥ prasīda bhagavannāgaccha svagṛhaṁ punaḥ||3||

brahmanah — the brahmanas; sadhavah — saintly; shantah — peaceful; vinayena — humbly; dvija-uttamah — the best of the twice-born; uchuh — said; prasida — be gracious; bhagavan — O Bhagavan; agachchha — come; sva-griham — to Your home; punah — again.

3The saintly, peaceful brahmanas, the best of the twice-born, said humbly: "Be gracious, Bhagavan! Come back again to Your home."

Verse 4

तच्छ्रुत्वा विनयं तेषां करुणार्द्रो न्यवर्तत।
स्वभक्तहृदयानन्दः श्रीमान्विश्वम्भरः प्रभुः॥४॥

tacchrutvā vinayaṁ teṣāṁ karuṇārdro nyavartata|
svabhaktahṛdayānandaḥ śrīmānviśvambharaḥ prabhuḥ||4||

tat — that; shrutva — hearing; vinayam — humble plea; tesham — their; karuna-ardrah — softened by compassion; nyavartata — turned back; sva-bhakta-hridaya-anandah — the joy of His devotees' hearts; shriman — the glorious; vishvambharah — Vishvambhara; prabhuh — the Lord.

4Hearing their humble plea, the glorious Lord Vishvambhara, the joy of His devotees' hearts, was softened by compassion and turned back.

Verse 5

ततस्ते हृष्टमनसस्त्यक्तशोका मुदान्विताः।
आजग्मुर्हरिणा सर्वे श्रीवासस्यालयं पुनः॥५॥

tataste hṛṣṭamanasastyaktaśokā mudānvitāḥ|
ājagmurhariṇā sarve śrīvāsasyālayaṁ punaḥ||5||

tatah — then; te — they; hrishta-manasah — glad at heart; tyakta-shokah — their grief cast off; muda-anvitah — full of joy; ajagmuh — came; harina — with Hari; sarve — all; shrivasasya — of Srivasa; alayam — to the house; punah — again.

5And then all of them, glad at heart, their grief cast off, full of joy, came again with Hari to the house of Srivasa.

Verse 6

प्रोवाच भगवांस्तत्र सर्वेषामेव सन्निधौ।
शृणुध्वं वचनं मह्यं यूयं कृष्णरसप्रदाः॥६॥

provāca bhagavāṁstatra sarveṣāmeva sannidhau|
śṛṇudhvaṁ vacanaṁ mahyaṁ yūyaṁ kṛṣṇarasapradāḥ||6||

provacha — said; bhagavan — Bhagavan; tatra — there; sarvesham eva — of all; sannidhau — in the presence; shrinudhvam — hear; vachanam — the word; mahyam — My; yuyam — you; krishna-rasa-pradah — givers of the rasa of Krishna.

6There Bhagavan said before them all: "Hear My word, you who give the rasa of Krishna.

Verse 7

मातरं संपरित्यज्य गते मयि दिगन्तरम्।
सर्वे मां संवदिष्यन्ति विरुद्धं कृतवानसौ॥७॥

mātaraṁ saṁparityajya gate mayi digantaram|
sarve māṁ saṁvadiṣyanti viruddhaṁ kṛtavānasau||7||

mataram — His mother; samparityajya — having abandoned; gate mayi — when I have gone; dik-antaram — to distant lands; sarve — all; mam — of Me; samvadishyanti — will say; viruddham — what is wrong; kritavan — has done; asau — He.

7When I abandon My mother and go away to distant lands, everyone will say of Me: 'He has done wrong.'"2

Verse 8

मुरारिः प्राह तं श्रुत्वा मैवं नाथ वदिष्यति।
कश्चिज्जनो न शक्नोति जीवो वक्तुं सनातनम्॥८॥

murāriḥ prāha taṁ śrutvā maivaṁ nātha vadiṣyati|
kaścijjano na śaknoti jīvo vaktuṁ sanātanam||8||

murarih — Murari; praha — said; tam — that; shrutva — hearing; ma evam — not so; natha — O Lord; vadishyati — will speak; kashchit — any; janah — person; na shaknoti — cannot; jivah — a living being; vaktum — speak; sanatanam — of the Eternal One.

8Hearing this, Murari said: "No, Lord, no one will say so. No person, no living being, is able to speak thus of the Eternal One."

Verse 9

तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भगवांस्तं मुरारिकम्।
आलिङ्ग्य वरबाहुभ्यां हृषितः प्राविशद्गृहम्॥९॥

tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā bhagavāṁstaṁ murārikam|
āliṅgya varabāhubhyāṁ hṛṣitaḥ prāviśadgṛham||9||

tasya — his; tat-vachanam — those words; shrutva — hearing; bhagavan — Bhagavan; tam — that; murarikam — humble Murari; alingya — embracing; vara-bahubhyam — with His beautiful arms; hrishitah — delighted; pravishat — entered; griham — the house.

9Hearing these words of his, Bhagavan, delighted, embraced humble Murari with His beautiful arms and entered the house.

Verse 10

ततः प्रमुदितो वैद्यः पुलकावलिमुद्वहन्।
पपाठ श्लोकमेकं च प्राचीनं यच्छृणुष्व तत्॥१०॥

tataḥ pramudito vaidyaḥ pulakāvalimudvahan|
papāṭha ślokamekaṁ ca prācīnaṁ yacchṛṇuṣva tat||10||

tatah — then; pramuditah — overjoyed; vaidyah — the physician; pulaka-avalim — rows of bristling hair; udvahan — bearing; papatha — recited; shlokam — a verse; ekam — one; cha — and; prachinam — ancient; yat — which; shrinushva — hear; tat — it.

10Then the physician, overjoyed, the hair of his body standing in rows, recited an ancient verse — hear it:

Verse 11

क्वाहं दरिद्रः पापीयान्क्व कृष्णः श्रीनिकेतनः।
ब्रह्मबन्धुरिति स्माहं बाहुभ्यां परिरम्भितः॥११॥

kvāhaṁ daridraḥ pāpīyānkva kṛṣṇaḥ śrīniketanaḥ|
brahmabandhuriti smāhaṁ bāhubhyāṁ parirambhitaḥ||11||

kva — where; aham — I; daridrah — a pauper; papiyan — most sinful; kva — and where; krishnah — Krishna; shri-niketanah — the abode of Shri (Lakshmi); brahma-bandhuh — a brahmana by birth alone; iti — as; sma — indeed; aham — I; bahubhyam — with His arms; parirambhitah — was embraced.

11"Where am I, a pauper, most sinful, and where is Krishna, the abode of Shri! And yet me, a brahmana by birth alone, He embraced with His arms."3

Verse 12

तच्छ्रुत्वाश्चर्यमखिलं भावं सन्दर्शयन्प्रभुः।
रराज सहसा देवः सहस्रार्चिःसमप्रभः॥१२॥

tacchrutvāścaryamakhilaṁ bhāvaṁ sandarśayanprabhuḥ|
rarāja sahasā devaḥ sahasrārciḥsamaprabhaḥ||12||

tat — that; shrutva — hearing; ashcharyam — wondrous; akhilam — complete; bhavam — state; sandarshayan — revealing; prabhuh — the Lord; raraja — shone; sahasa — suddenly; devah — the Lord; sahasra-archih-sama-prabhah — with splendour like the thousand-rayed (sun).

12Hearing this, the Lord revealed a wondrous and complete state and suddenly shone forth, His splendour like that of the thousand-rayed sun.

Verse 13

उपविश्यासने देवः प्रोवाच मधुराक्षरम्।
इदं देहं विजानीहि सच्चिद्घनमनुत्तमम्॥१३॥

upaviśyāsane devaḥ provāca madhurākṣaram|
idaṁ dehaṁ vijānīhi saccidghanamanuttamam||13||

upavishya — sitting; asane — on the seat; devah — the Lord; provacha — spoke; madhura-aksharam — in sweet words; idam — this; deham — body; vijanihi — know; sat-chit-ghanam — concentrated being and consciousness; anuttamam — supreme.

13Sitting down on His seat, the Lord spoke sweetly: "Know this body to be the supreme concentration of being and consciousness."

Verse 14

ततस्ते मुदिताः सर्वे बभूवुः पुलकाञ्चिताः।
श्रीवासपण्डितस्तत्र स्नापयामास तं प्रभुम्॥१४॥

tataste muditāḥ sarve babhūvuḥ pulakāñcitāḥ|
śrīvāsapaṇḍitastatra snāpayāmāsa taṁ prabhum||14||

tatah — then; te — they; muditah — delighted; sarve — all; babhuvuh — became; pulaka-anchitah — covered with bristling hair; shrivasa-panditah — Srivasa Pandita; tatra — there; snapayam asa — bathed; tam — that; prabhum — Lord.

14And all of them rejoiced, and the hair of their bodies stood on end. Then Srivasa Pandita bathed the Lord

Verse 15

स्वर्नदीस्वच्छसलिलैः पूजां चक्रे यथाविधि।
नित्यानन्दो महातेजाश्छत्रं शिरस्यधारयत्॥१५॥

svarnadīsvacchasalilaiḥ pūjāṁ cakre yathāvidhi|
nityānando mahātejāśchatraṁ śirasyadhārayat||15||

svar-nadi-svachchha-salilaih — with the clear waters of the heavenly river; pujam — worship; chakre — performed; yatha-vidhi — according to rule; nityanandah — Nityananda; maha-tejah — of great splendour; chhatram — an umbrella; shirasi — over the head; adharayat — held.

15with the clear waters of the heavenly river and worshipped Him according to rule; Nityananda, of great splendour, held an umbrella over His head.

Verse 16

गदाधरश्च ताम्बूलं ददाति श्रीमुखोपरि।
केचित्सेवन्ते तं देवं चामरव्यजनादिभिः॥१६॥

gadādharaśca tāmbūlaṁ dadāti śrīmukhopari|
kecitsevante taṁ devaṁ cāmaravyajanādibhiḥ||16||

gadadharah — Gadadhara; cha — and; tambulam — betel; dadati — gives; shri-mukha-upari — to the beautiful mouth; kechit — some; sevante — serve; tam — that; devam — Lord; chamara-vyajana-adibhih — with chamara whisks, fans and the like.

16Gadadhara offers betel to His beautiful lips, and others serve the Lord with chamara whisks, fans and the like.

Verse 17

सङ्कीर्तनरसे मग्ना हरिं गायन्ति सर्वतः।
एवं कौतुकमापन्ना विस्मिता ननृतुर्जगुः॥१७॥

saṅkīrtanarase magnā hariṁ gāyanti sarvataḥ|
evaṁ kautukamāpannā vismitā nanṛturjaguḥ||17||

sankirtana-rase — in the rasa of sankirtana; magnah — immersed; harim — of Hari; gayanti — sing; sarvatah — on every side; evam — thus; kautukam — rapture; apannah — having entered; vismitah — amazed; nanrituh — danced; jaguh — sang.

17Immersed in the rasa of sankirtana, they sing of Hari on every side; and so, in rapture and amazement, they danced and sang.

Thus ends the twelfth sarga, "The Great Manifestation and the Ablution" (Mahaprakasha-abhisheka), of the second prakrama of the poem "Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita."

✦

Notes

  1. Vijaya is apparently Vijaya Dasa, a devotee of Navadvipa and a copyist of books.
  2. The Lord is already contemplating sannyasa, for which He will have to leave His mother.
  3. Bhagavata Purana 10.81.16 — the words of the poor brahmana Sudama, whom Krishna embraced. Murari applies them to himself.
